sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 2450 of 2024

Petitioner :- Smt. Kutan And Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Civil Secrt. Lko. And Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Vishal Kumar Yadav,Santosh Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

The petitioners seek issuance of a writ in the nature of certiorari for quashing of the First Information Report dated 30.06.2023 bearing Case Crime No. 0137 of 2023 under Sections 498A,
323, 308, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahanagar, District- Lucknow.

After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the petitioners prays to withdraw the present writ Smt. Kutan And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164258014/
1 petition with liberty to seek other remedy.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to the petitioners to take appropriate remedy as permissible in law before appropriate court.
